title: Correct resistance force
description: Essential: The student must state or calculate the resistance force as 450 N (or equivalent).

title: Correct work done
description: Essential: The student must state or calculate the work done as 9.0 × 10³ J (or 9000 J).

title: Correct total power
description: Essential: The student must state or calculate the total power as 600 W.

title: Equilibrium reasoning
description: Important: The student must apply Newton's first law, stating that net horizontal force is zero due to constant velocity.

title: Horizontal component of tension
description: Important: The student must correctly use the cosine of the angle to find the horizontal component of each tension force.

title: Work formula application
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the work formula W = Fx cosθ for the total horizontal force and distance.

title: Power definition
description: Important: The student must correctly define power as work done divided by time taken.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's solution should maintain consistent SI units (N, m, J, W) throughout.

title: Forgetting cosine factor
description: Pitfall: Using tension F directly without the cosθ factor for horizontal force in equilibrium or work calculation.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigning sign to work or power, or misinterpreting the direction of forces.
